comment: The module has no parameters, inputs or outputs, so there is nothing on it to click for help beyond the panel itself; everything it does is done to the rack's cables and through its context menu. Inklen publish no source, and the panel is drawn in code rather than from an SVG — the installed res folder holds only a font. The maker's manual is the whole record here, read on 2026-09-12 against the installed 2.0.3. Every menu item name above was checked against the installed build one at a time; two were wrong before this pass and are corrected here: the item reads 'Key mappings active always', not 'always active', and the two load and save items read 'from/to', not 'to/from'. The plugin-wide Theme submenu (Default Theme, Neumorphic, Skeumorphic Light and Dark, High Contrast Light and Dark, Default Light and Dark) is cosmetic and gets no line.
